issue.title: GenericSystem rejects controller reference interfaces when calculate_dynamics is enabled
issue.body:
## **Describe the bug**

When using two `JointTrajectoryController` instances chained to one `PidController`, controller activation fails with `mock_components/GenericSystem` when `calculate_dynamics` is enabled.

The controller chain is:

```text
arm_group_controller     ─┐
                           ├──> pid_controller ───> GenericSystem
gripper_group_controller ─┘
```

The first JTC can be activated, but the second JTC fails. Swapping the startup order changes which JTC fails.

The same configuration works with `gazebo_ros2_control/GazeboSystem`.

### ros2_controllers.yaml

```yaml
controller_manager:
  ros__parameters:
    update_rate: 100

    joint_state_broadcaster:
      type: joint_state_broadcaster/JointStateBroadcaster

    pid_controller:
      type: pid_controller/PidController

    arm_group_controller:
      type: joint_trajectory_controller/JointTrajectoryController

    gripper_group_controller:
      type: joint_trajectory_controller/JointTrajectoryController


pid_controller:
  ros__parameters:
    dof_names:
      - joint1
      - joint2

    reference_and_state_dof_names:
      - joint1
      - joint2

    command_interface: velocity

    reference_and_state_interfaces:
      - position

    use_external_measured_states: false

    gains:
      joint1:
        p: 1.0
        i: 0.0
        d: 0.0

      joint2:
        p: 1.0
        i: 0.0
        d: 0.0


arm_group_controller:
  ros__parameters:
    joints:
      - joint1

    command_joints:
      - pid_controller/joint1

    command_interfaces:
      - position

    state_interfaces:
      - position

    state_publish_rate: 50.0
    action_monitor_rate: 20.0
    allow_partial_joints_goal: false
    open_loop_control: false


gripper_group_controller:
  ros__parameters:
    joints:
      - joint2

    command_joints:
      - pid_controller/joint2

    command_interfaces:
      - position

    state_interfaces:
      - position

    state_publish_rate: 50.0
    action_monitor_rate: 20.0
    allow_partial_joints_goal: false
    open_loop_control: false
```

### rrbot.urdf.xacro

This uses the standard RRBot model from `ros2_control_demo_description`:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>

<robot
  xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro"
  name="rrbot_pid_jtc_poc">

  <xacro:include
    filename="$(find ros2_control_demo_description)/rrbot/urdf/rrbot_description.urdf.xacro"/>

  <xacro:include
    filename="$(find ros2_control_demo_description)/rrbot/urdf/rrbot.materials.xacro"/>

  <link name="world"/>

  <xacro:rrbot parent="world" prefix="">
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </xacro:rrbot>

  <ros2_control name="RRBotPIDJTC" type="system">
    <hardware>
      <plugin>mock_components/GenericSystem</plugin>
      <param name="calculate_dynamics">true</param>
    </hardware>

    <joint name="joint1">
      <command_interface name="velocity"/>
      <state_interface name="position">
        <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
      </state_interface>
    </joint>

    <joint name="joint2">
      <command_interface name="velocity"/>
      <state_interface name="position">
        <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
      </state_interface>
    </joint>
  </ros2_control>
</robot>
```

## **To Reproduce**

1. Start `controller_manager` with the RRBot description and controller configuration:

   ```bash
   ros2 run controller_manager ros2_control_node \
     --ros-args \
     -p robot_description:="$(xacro rrbot.urdf.xacro)" \
     --params-file ros2_controllers.yaml
   ```

2. In another terminal, start the controllers in this order:

   ```bash
   ros2 run controller_manager spawner joint_state_broadcaster \
     -c /controller_manager

   ros2 run controller_manager spawner pid_controller \
     -c /controller_manager

   ros2 run controller_manager spawner arm_group_controller \
     -c /controller_manager

   ros2 run controller_manager spawner gripper_group_controller \
     -c /controller_manager
   ```

3. Inspect the controller and hardware interface states:

   ```bash
   ros2 control list_controllers
   ros2 control list_hardware_interfaces
   ros2 control view_controller_chains
   ```

4. The first JTC is activated successfully.

5. The second JTC fails during activation with an error similar to:

   ```text
   [mock_generic_system]: Joint 'joint2' has to have
   'position', 'velocity', or 'acceleration' interface!

   [resource_manager]: Component 'RRBotPIDJTC' did not accept
   command interfaces combination
   ```

6. If the JTC startup order is swapped, the other JTC fails instead.

## **Expected behavior**

Both JTC controllers should activate successfully:

```text
joint_state_broadcaster    active
pid_controller              active
arm_group_controller        active
gripper_group_controller    active
```

The hardware command interfaces should remain:

```text
joint1/velocity
joint2/velocity
```

The controller reference interfaces should be accepted independently:

```text
pid_controller/joint1/position
pid_controller/joint2/position
```

## **Screenshots**

Not applicable. The failure is demonstrated by the controller manager log output.

## **Environment (please complete the following information):**

- OS: Ubuntu 22.04
- ROS 2 version: Humble
- `ros2_control`: built from source
- `ros2_controllers`: built from source
- Hardware plugin: `mock_components/GenericSystem`
- Controller chain:
  - Two `JointTrajectoryController` instances
  - One `PidController`
- `calculate_dynamics`: enabled
- The same configuration works with `gazebo_ros2_control/GazeboSystem`

## **Additional context**

The hardware exports:

```text
joint1/velocity
joint2/velocity
joint1/position
joint2/position
```

The PID controller exports the following reference interfaces:

```text
pid_controller/joint1/position
pid_controller/joint2/position
```

The failure occurs only when:

```xml
<param name="calculate_dynamics">true</param>
```

is enabled. With `calculate_dynamics=false`, `GenericSystem::prepare_command_mode_switch()` returns early and the controllers activate.

The relevant implementation in `GenericSystem` uses substring matching:

```cpp
auto joint_it_found = std::find_if(
  info_.joints.begin(), info_.joints.end(),
  [key](const auto & joint)
  {
    return (key.find(joint.name) != std::string::npos);
  });
```

This associates:

```text
pid_controller/joint2/position
```

with the hardware joint:

```text
joint2
```

The implementation then checks whether the full key equals one of:

```text
joint2/position
joint2/velocity
joint2/acceleration
```

and reports an error because the controller reference interface is not a hardware control-mode interface.

`GazeboSystem` does not show this failure because it only handles exact hardware interface names and ignores the controller reference interfaces.

A potential fix is to make `GenericSystem::prepare_command_mode_switch()` and `perform_command_mode_switch()` match only exact hardware interface names, for example:

```cpp
return (
  key == joint.name + "/" + hardware_interface::HW_IF_POSITION ||
  key == joint.name + "/" + hardware_interface::HW_IF_VELOCITY ||
  key == joint.name + "/" + hardware_interface::HW_IF_ACCELERATION);
```

This prevents controller reference interfaces from being interpreted as hardware joint interfaces.

## P.S.

Content generated by agent, but verified and reproduced by human. 
Below patch fixes the thing. 
```diff
diff --git a/hardware_interface/src/mock_components/generic_system.cpp b/hardware_interface/src/mock_components/generic_system.cpp
index b216c708..1632f2d6 100644
--- a/hardware_interface/src/mock_components/generic_system.cpp
+++ b/hardware_interface/src/mock_components/generic_system.cpp
@@ -389,10 +389,19 @@ return_type GenericSystem::prepare_command_mode_switch(
 
   for (const auto & key : start_interfaces)
   {
-    // check if interface is joint
+    // Only handle interfaces owned by this hardware component. Controller
+    // reference interfaces (for example
+    // "pid_controller/joint_name/position") are also present in the command
+    // interface switch request, but must not select a hardware control mode.
     auto joint_it_found = std::find_if(
       info_.joints.begin(), info_.joints.end(),
-      [key](const auto & joint) { return (key.find(joint.name) != std::string::npos); });
+      [key](const auto & joint)
+      {
+        return (
+          key == joint.name + "/" + hardware_interface::HW_IF_POSITION ||
+          key == joint.name + "/" + hardware_interface::HW_IF_VELOCITY ||
+          key == joint.name + "/" + hardware_interface::HW_IF_ACCELERATION);
+      });
 
     if (joint_it_found != info_.joints.end())
     {
@@ -478,10 +487,17 @@ return_type GenericSystem::perform_command_mode_switch(
 
   for (const auto & key : start_interfaces)
   {
-    // check if interface is joint
+    // Ignore controller reference interfaces and handle only exact hardware
+    // interface names.
     auto joint_it_found = std::find_if(
       info_.joints.begin(), info_.joints.end(),
-      [key](const auto & joint) { return (key.find(joint.name) != std::string::npos); });
+      [key](const auto & joint)
+      {
+        return (
+          key == joint.name + "/" + hardware_interface::HW_IF_POSITION ||
+          key == joint.name + "/" + hardware_interface::HW_IF_VELOCITY ||
+          key == joint.name + "/" + hardware_interface::HW_IF_ACCELERATION);
+      });
 
     if (joint_it_found != info_.joints.end())
     {
```
